findings.title: System Daemon Account Mapped to Active Shell

findings.title: Insecure System OpenSSL TLS Policy (TLS 1.0 Allowed)
findings.description: System OpenSSL policy permits deprecated TLS 1.0 protocol and SECLEVEL=0 weak ciphers.

framework_mappings.title: Transmission security - Strong TLS Policy enforcement

findings.rag_ai_remediation: Reconfigure merchant_production_env/etc/ssl/openssl.cnf to enforce MinProtocol = TLSv1.2 or TLSv1.3 and set SECLEVEL=2. Disable legacy TLS 1.0, TLS 1.1, and SSL 3.0 protocols per PCI-DSS Requirement 4.2.1.

findings.title: Insecure SSH Protocol & Weak Cryptographic Ciphers
findings.description: SSH configuration enables insecure protocols/ciphers: Protocol 1, Weak Ciphers (Blowfish/3DES), Weak MACs (HMAC-MD5).

framework_mappings.title: Technical Safeguards - Insecure management transmission protocols

findings.rag_ai_remediation: Update merchant_production_env/etc/ssh/sshd_config to enforce SSH Protocol 2. Disable obsolete Blowfish/3DES ciphers and HMAC-MD5 MAC algorithms per PCI-DSS Requirement 2.2.4.

findings.title: Insecure Web Server TLS Configuration
findings.description: Nginx configuration enables deprecated TLS 1.0/1.1 protocols and weak RC4/3DES ciphers.

framework_mappings.title: Transmission security - Strong TLS Policy enforcement

findings.rag_ai_remediation: Reconfigure merchant_production_env/etc/nginx/conf.d/ssl_policy.conf to enforce MinProtocol = TLSv1.2 or TLSv1.3 and set SECLEVEL=2. Disable legacy TLS 1.0, TLS 1.1, and SSL 3.0 protocols per PCI-DSS Requirement 4.2.1.
